Elena —

Hope you had a good weekend. AlphaWave’s account is up for renewal 12/20 and I wanted to start the conversation around strengthening the SLA and accommodating the steady growth we saw this quarter. Two quick points up front: 

- Usage trend: your Q3 -> Q4 forecast shows ~65% token growth month-over-month on inference. I attached the raw usage export so we can baseline.
- Options we recommend: (A) Premium SLA (99.95% availability, tighter p95/p99 latency SLOs) on Hosted with reserved burst capacity; (B) Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) for predictable latency at scale.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal planning: premium SLA + capacity options (AW-4372)

Team —

Following up from Dylan’s thread with AlphaWave. I sketched a recommended path based on their usage curve and contract timing:

- Phase 1 (renewal start, 12/20): Premium SLA on Hosted with a reserved burst buffer (adds ~20% capacity headroom) — target p95 < 120ms, p99 < 380ms on 512-token baseline.
- Phase 2 (Q1 post-renewal): Move to Dedicated pool if monthly average tokens exceed the threshold in the quote (we tie this to a usage band to make it optional). Dedicated reduces unit cost ~18% and tightens tail latency to p95 < 90ms, p99 < 250ms.
- Commercials: Propose a 12-month renewal with a 10% uplift for Premium SLA and an option to transition to Dedicated with a one-time onboarding fee. Offer one month of credits (usage offset) as a renewal incentive.

I attached a starter quote (will convert to PDF). For compliance asks: we will provide SOC2 Type II summary report, SSO integration guide, and KMS options for key management during the procurement stage.

Next actions I recommend:
- Dylan: align on the Thursday 11/05 call and capture any technical follow-ups.
- Ben: help size the Dedicated GPU pool assumption and confirm onboarding timeline (2–3 weeks).
- Stephanie: draft a concise renewal one-pager for AlphaWave procurement (SLA bullets + pricing).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Elena / Ken —

Thanks again for taking the meeting last week. Per follow-up from our team I’ve attached the consolidated PDF quote (redwood-premium-sla-quote.pdf) and a short FAQ. Highlights: 

- Premium SLA (Hosted): p95 < 120ms, p99 < 380ms (measured on your current prompt-length distribution).
- Dedicated option: estimated uplift cost ~ +18% in monthly committed spend, onboarding window 10 business days after contract signature.
- Renewal credit: one month of service credit conditioning on 12-month renewal.
- Canary: we can schedule a 14-day canary prior to the Dedication migration window to validate tail latency under your workload.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/AW-4372) and DocuSign link for a preliminary amendment: https://www.docusign.com/drive/s/aw-4372-premium-sla

Please let us know if procurement needs any specific artifact (SOC2 report/sso guide). We’re happy to start the DocuSign path once you confirm the approach.

Best,
Dylan
